compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: merge-to-main-pr.sh commits the version-bump on the source branch's HEAD before initiating session\xe2\x86\x92main merge.
- DD2: The bump commit carries a provenance trailer (DSO-Story-Merge: or coordinated trailer).
- DD5: SC4(b) sub-PR commit history shows bump on source branch.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh`:

1. **Add a new pre-merge phase** `_phase_source_branch_version_bump` invoked BEFORE PR creation/update (i.e., before the existing _phase_merge / gh pr create flow):
   - Check working state: session branch is checked out; origin/main has been fetched; session branch is up to date with origin/main.
   - Invoke the existing version-bump logic (reusing the bump helper from merge-to-main-direct.sh, sourced for library mode at line 2040 area) but target the SOURCE BRANCH HEAD instead of MAIN_REPO/main.
   - Apply the provenance trailer to the bump commit body:
     ```
     <version-bump commit subject>

     DSO-Story-Merge: <story-id>
     ```
     The trailer grammar must match what S1.T5's extended verify-session-provenance.sh accepts: `^DSO-Story(-Merge)?:`. Use `DSO-Story-Merge:` for consistency with existing emitters (merge-story-branch.sh).
   - On resume (`_RESUME=1`), detect whether the bump commit is already on the source branch HEAD (via `git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep '^DSO-Story-Merge:'` or equivalent) and skip re-committing.
   - On failure (push rejected, non-fast-forward), bail loud — do NOT continue to merge with an unbumped state.

2. **Modify the existing post-merge `_phase_version_bump`** (lines 2266\xe2\x80\x932331 area) to detect whether the merged commit already contains the bump:
   - Read the merged commit's diff for the version file.
   - If the version is already bumped (i.e., S5's pre-merge phase ran successfully), mark `_state_mark_complete("version_bump")` and skip. Log: "Post-merge version_bump: source-branch bump detected on merged commit \xe2\x80\x94 phase no-op."
   - Otherwise (fall-through for backward-compat with old workflows), preserve the existing direct-to-main bump path. Log a deprecation note.

3. **Inline doc**: add a comment block at the new phase explaining the design decision (bump-before-final-review) and referencing this story ticket.

After implementation: T1's RED test must pass GREEN. Remove `.test-index` marker.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` | modify | `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` (modified in T1) + sibling tests | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | remove marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (shellcheck clean)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] merge-to-main-pr.sh contains _phase_source_branch_version_bump function
  Verify: grep -qE '_phase_source_branch_version_bump|source.branch.*version' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Trailer grammar matches DSO-Story-Merge: or DSO-Story:
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO-Story.*Merge|DSO-Story:' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Post-merge _phase_version_bump detects pre-bumped state and no-ops
  Verify: grep -qE 'already.*bump|pre.merge.*bump.*detect|source.branch.*bump.*detect' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] T1's source-branch bump test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] .test-index no longer carries source-branch-bump RED marker
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_merge_to_main_pr_source_branch_bump\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Existing test-merge-to-main-pr*.sh suite still passes (sibling tests unaffected)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-resume-and-stale.sh && bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-story-base.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user

comments.body:
AC AMENDMENTS consolidated (plan-review F1, F2, F3, F4 + gap-analysis F2, F3, F4, F6):

**Plan-review F1 (codebase audit)**: Verify bump-version.sh line 85 branch guard ('Refusing to run on primary checkout') is compatible with running on a feature/session branch. Document in the function header that DSO_MERGE_TO_MAIN_PHASE=version_bump remains vestigial on source-branch execution but is preserved for downstream signal consumers.

**Plan-review F2 + gap-analysis F3 (resume safety)**: REPLACE the 'grep commit body for DSO-Story-Merge:' detection signal. Use INSTEAD: 'git diff --quiet -- "$_VERSION_FILE"' as the idempotency gate (matches existing _phase_version_bump pattern). If the version file is already bumped on the source branch HEAD, skip re-committing. Alternative: dedicated state-file phase entry source_branch_version_bump.

**Plan-review F3 + gap-analysis F2 (push timing + abort on failure)**: After committing the bump on the source branch, push immediately: 'git push origin HEAD'. If push fails (non-fast-forward, hook rejection, network error), the script MUST exit non-zero, log full stderr, mark state.json source_branch_version_bump=failed, and NOT proceed to gh pr merge. Add unit test mocking push failure.

**Plan-review F4 (multi-file no-op detection)**: Post-merge _phase_version_bump no-op detection uses 'git diff --cached --quiet' as the final skip gate (covers package-lock.json + version file together), not version-file-only check.

**Gap-analysis F4 (orphan cleanup retarget)**: _try_reset_stale_version_bump must EITHER (a) be retargeted to scan source branch for stale pre-merge bumps from aborted prior runs, OR (b) explicitly documented as legacy-direct-mode-only with an early-return guard when merge.strategy=pr. Include test.

**Gap-analysis F6 (forward-compat state.json)**: Handle state.json from pre-S5 in-flight PRs gracefully. If state.json shows phase=version_bump (legacy post-merge name) and PR not yet merged, EITHER migrate to phase=source_branch_version_bump and retry pre-merge flow, OR fall through to legacy post-merge bump for that one PR with deprecation log. Add unit test seeding pre-S5 state.json.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] bump-version.sh line 85 guard audited and documented in T2 commit message
  Verify: grep -qE 'bump-version.sh.*line 85|primary checkout|branch guard' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Resume idempotency uses 'git diff --quiet -- \${_VERSION_FILE}' not commit-body grep
  Verify: grep -qE 'git diff --quiet.*version|already.*bump' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Pre-merge push failure aborts pipeline before merge
  Verify: grep -qE 'push.*fail|push.*reject.*exit' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Post-merge no-op uses 'git diff --cached --quiet' final gate
  Verify: grep -q 'git diff --cached --quiet' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] _try_reset_stale_version_bump retargeted OR documented legacy-only
  Verify: grep -qE 'merge.strategy=pr|legacy.*direct.mode|source.branch.*stale' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Pre-S5 state.json migration handled
  Verify: grep -qE 'pre.S5|legacy.*phase.version_bump|state\.json.*migrate' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
